summary.text: ETEKA AS is a private limited company registered in Sveio, founded 1999-03-20. ETEKA AS produserer kalesjer, presenninger og møbelinnredning. Its main industry code is 13.960: manufacture of other technical and industrial textiles. The register shows 5 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 317 456 NOK and the annual result was 485 371 NOK; operating income was up from 3 517 862 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 65 138 NOK in 2024 to 485 371 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 842 937 NOK in 2024 to 1 328 308 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is eteka.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The registered employee count went from 6 on 2026-02-13 to 5 on 2026-10-14. Recent changes in the register: email set to leder@eteka.no on 2026-02-12.
